title: Remove a package and its dependencies on Arch Linux
summary: Uninstall a specific software package and remove any dependencies that are no longer needed by other packages.

steps.explain: Remove the specified package and its dependencies. Replace <PACKAGE_NAME> with the name of the software you want to remove.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the package to remove

rollback.explain: Reinstall the package if you removed it by mistake.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the package to reinstall

warnings: Check the list of packages to be removed before confirming to ensure you don't delete something important.
